verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and texting platform that sends SMS from US local numbers, so guided A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration with approval-status tracking is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions 10DLC, brand or campaign registration, carrier compliance, or approval status. The texting and number-setup material is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the product walks me through US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and shows the approval status
